prose: Mario Garza is a graphic artist and producer of concise & informative videos revealing the broad depth and history of spiritual and occult symbolism, which can be found on his channel Symbolic Studies. In this episode we discuss Simulacra, Simulation & the Heliocentric hex, the Polar-Toroidal Fractal, Mercury, magick, magnetism and the astrological skyclock.
ext: We explore the circumpolar heavens, Ursa Major, Lovecraftian black magic, the septenary & ascension rituals, secret society & mystery school symbolism of reincarnation, serpents & the cycles of life, the Kumbh Mela, Age of Aquarius, and the layers of density in our etheric realm.
